summary: Build “7 Bucks” payment app: admin dashboard captures ContiPay API tokens (stored encrypted), backend (Motoko canister) securely performs ContiPay acquire/disburse flows to convert card charge to EcoCash FCA USD payout, with a modern UI showing user savings vs ATM.
architectural_notes: Store ContiPay API tokens encrypted; tokens entered by admin via dashboard and persisted in backend canister.
All ContiPay API calls should be executed server-side (most secure), not from the frontend.
PWA support requires a valid web app manifest, service worker registration, and correctly referenced icon assets (favicon/app icons) served from stable URLs.
known_issues: 7 Bucks logo image is failing to load (broken image icon) on the login page; likely missing/incorrect asset path or build export issue.

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity sign-in and an Admin-only area where an authenticated admin can enter, update, and save ContiPay credentials (API key, secret, and any required merchant identifiers/fields) for later use.
Ensure the most secure architecture: all ContiPay API calls must be performed by the Motoko backend (the frontend must never call ContiPay directly or handle raw ContiPay secrets).

Create the end-user payment flow UI (single page or multi-step wizard) to collect: student card number, CVV, expiry; parent EcoCash phone/identifier; and amount in USD. The UI must display the savings message (e.g., “You save $21 compared to the ATM”) and show success/failure status for the transaction.

Add a minimal transaction log/ledger in the backend for operational visibility (timestamps, amount_usd, total_to_charge, status, and returned references), and a simple Admin view to list recent transactions (no sensitive card data stored or displayed).

Brand the app as “7 Bucks” and incorporate the user-provided logo throughout the UI (header/login/admin/payment screens), including generating appropriate app icon/favicon assets derived from the uploaded logo image.

Apply a cohesive, modern visual theme consistent with the “7 Bucks” brand (teal + gold tones from the logo, strong typography, clear step-by-step layout), and enforce the style consistently across all screens.
Fix the broken 7 Bucks logo image so it reliably loads on the login screen and in the authenticated header, with a graceful fallback if the image asset cannot be loaded.

Add a PWA install experience: ensure the app is properly configured as a PWA (web app manifest + icons + service worker) and provide an in-app install prompt/button with English user-facing text (e.g., "Install app") that appears only when installation is supported.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin dashboard to input/update ContiPay API tokens and persist them encrypted
Backend performs secure ContiPay payment flow: acquire card funds then disburse to EcoCash FCA USD
User payment UI flow (single or multi-screen) to collect student card details and parent EcoCash number and show result/status
Display savings message vs ATM (e.g., “You save $21 compared to the ATM”)
Branding: set app name to “7 Bucks” and use provided logo
Encrypt ContiPay credentials before persisting them in the Motoko canister, and ensure they are never returned in plaintext via any query/update method.

Implement backend payment orchestration methods that (once ContiPay endpoints/specs are provided) perform: (1) acquire/charge funds for amount_usd * 1.07 in USD; then (2) disburse/payout amount_usd to EcoCash FCA USD. Until exact ContiPay REST endpoints/fields are provided, the backend must still “function” by rejecting with a clear actionable error explaining what configuration/spec is missing (endpoints and required fields).
Add PWA install prompt (e.g., "Install app") on supported browsers and ensure PWA is properly configured (manifest + icons + service worker)
